text: The existing repair lesson already records resetting IMAP counts and UID validity while preserving view settings. The current caller additionally explains that the string "-1" is kUidUnknown and names nsImapMailFolder::UpdateImapMailboxInfo as the consumer. The current consumer compares stored UID validity with the server value and calls HandleUidInvalidation on a mismatch. Manual comment proposal for this boundary: name the protocol meaning and the consumer beside a serialized numeric sentinel, instead of leaving a bare magic string. Do not replace the value with a differently typed constant without checking the property-bag representation. Current source, not private review prose, supports this proposal; the cached review summary remains private and incomplete for replay.
title: Explain protocol sentinels at the repair boundary where they are serialized
